description: Omnicom Group Inc. is a leading global advertising and marketing services company, providing brand advertising, brand consulting, media planning and buying, branding, merchandising and point of sale, content marketing, mobile marketing, crisis communications, multi-cultural marketing, customer data analytics and data-driven decision making, organizational communications, customer relationship management, package design, decision sciences and performance marketing. On November 26, 2025 it completed its merger with IPG, with IPG becoming a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Omnicom and each outstanding share of IPG common stock, other than certain excluded shares, converting into the right to receive 0.344 shares of Omnicom common stock and cash in lieu of fractional shares, following which legacy Omnicom shareholders owned approximately 60.6 percent of the combined company and legacy IPG shareholders owned approximately 39.4 percent, on a fully diluted basis.
